bug_locations: rolling_mean function - missing null (None) return when fewer than min_periods values are available
rolling_mean function - missing validation that 1 <= min_periods <= window
explanation: Three bugs were present: (1) The original code only validated window > 0 but did not validate that 1 <= min_periods <= window as required by the spec. (2) The original code never returned null/None for positions where the number of available values is less than min_periods; it always computed a mean. (3) The logic needed to check len(segment) >= min_periods before computing the mean, otherwise return None. The fix adds proper validation of min_periods and conditionally returns None when the segment length is below min_periods.
